reader_summary.overview: Matt Whineray is the CEO of New Zealand Superannuation Fund or Super Fund, one of the highest performing. The New Zealand government created the Super Fund in 2001 to help defray the costs of retirees in the country in the decades to come. Matt joined the organization in 2008 and became the CEO in 2018 and oversees NZ$42 billion.

key_points.text: Matt Whineray is the CEO of New Zealand Superannuation Fund or Super Fund, one of the highest performing.
Our conversation starts with Matt's background and the creation and objectives of the Super Fund.
We then walk through the Super Fund's investment philosophy, which is guided by four competitive advantages or endowments and nine investment beliefs.
